items.t: Loss of drive power from engine software (recall)
items.job: Reprogram engine and powertrain computers under recall

items.t: Loss of power in EV mode from inverter software (recall)

items.job: Update body control module software under recall

items.t: Defroster, seat belt chime or 360 camera may not work (recall)
items.job: Reprogram dash electrical supply unit under recall

items.t: Hybrid System Malfunction warning with power loss
items.job: Diagnose hybrid system and install software updates
items.note: Covered under the hybrid and new-vehicle warranty on these young vehicles.

items.t: Jerky or hesitant shifting at low speed
items.job: Check and install transmission software updates
items.note: Covered under warranty; cost is mainly diagnostic time.

items.t: Shudder or grinding on sharp left turns
items.job: Repair engine mount stopper clearance per bulletin

items.t: Check engine light from the fuel vapor system
items.job: Diagnose evaporative system; replace pressure sensor or valve if needed
items.note: Emissions parts have extended federal warranty coverage.

items.job: Diagnose and repair telematics communication fault

items.t: Power liftgate won't open or reverses before closing
items.job: Update power liftgate control module software
Replace front seat cushion trim cover
items.note: Usually covered under warranty if reported early.

items.t: Engine shuts off at a stop and warning light comes on
items.job: Test and replace 12-volt battery; check for software updates
Inspect and recalibrate blind spot radar sensors

items.t: Center screen goes black, reboots or CarPlay drops
Can't shift to Neutral when the battery is dead
items.job: Jump or replace 12-volt battery; flatbed tow if needed
items.note: Most of the cost is the tow or a new battery if the old one is worn out.

items.t: Rattle from the overhead map light
items.job: Add headliner pad behind map light

items.t: Dust gets inside through the rear door gap
items.job: Inspect door seals and gap (no fix released yet)
Telematics diagnosis and connected service reset
